hypothesis: On the same extracted excerpts, does source-span and participant binding reduce mechanism misbinding?
scope: All13 previously exposed original HIV ART inputs; author-answer agreement only, no new clinical gold.
controls: One shared extraction per input/model and two final calls. Each arm depends on2 calls; actual new calls13x2x3=78. Same final template, original native system/question/options, quote-only rendering. Bound filters excerpt provenance and named participants; unfiltered passes all usable extracted quotes.
budget: Original seed42,temperature.7,max2048 per call,M4guided/M5unguided,batch4. Extraction has its own three-field record schema. No reference/ratings/source metadata or old answer enters inference.
interpretation: Bound changes evidence amount as well as anchoring. Shared extraction may omit necessary participants; co-mention and quote existence do not prove a relationship, causal sufficiency, treatment presence or target match. Generic classes/aliases may be lost. Empty selection becomes question-only with no hidden fallback.
decision: One common candidate, no item/model selection, all outputs retained. Compare same-extraction unfiltered, prior-stage single redo and two-call revision descriptively; only bound-vs-unfiltered isolates this filtering treatment. Review13 cases and selected/rejected spans.
